title: July 31st - Discontinuing of the Coaxial Cable System
summary: The Board of Directors has approved the discontinuation of the coaxial cable system, effective July 31, 2026. What This Means for You After July 31, 2026, television and internet services will be available only through the fiber-optic cable system. The existing coaxial cable system will no longer be operational.
